scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8875 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory build/web
scripts.lint: biome lint web tests tools/check.mjs && cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings
scripts.format: biome format --write web tests tools/check.mjs package.json tsconfig.json biome.json && cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: biome format web tests tools/check.mjs package.json tsconfig.json biome.json && cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
